segments.title: 第120章 美妙的事故
segments.content:
Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 120: A Wonderful Accident

When Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu returned to the stands, Li Luo's group of five had already stepped onto the constructed stage.

Niu Qingling's drum set and Xie Shuchen's keyboard were positioned at the two back corners of the stage respectively.

In the center were Li Luo, Yan Zhusheng, and Shao Youpeng, forming a triangle.

With Yan Zhusheng occupying the center position.

"Can you play any instruments, senior?" With her hands resting on the railing at the edge of the stands, Ying Chanxi gazed at Li Luo on the stage, chatting idly with Xu Youyu.

"I'm a musical idiot," Xu Youyu said with a chuckle. "My mom did take me to lessons when I was little, but whether it was piano, violin, or the xiao and dizi, I couldn't learn a single thing. What about you, Xixi?"

"Me... I learned piano for a while in elementary school." Ying Chanxi pursed her lips. "But later, to focus on my studies, I didn't continue."

"That's a bit of a shame," Xu Youyu said regretfully. "Otherwise, you might have been able to share the stage with Li Luo and the others right now."

"It's alright." Ying Chanxi shook her head with a smile. "I think watching them perform from down here is pretty nice too."

"Let's not talk for now." Xu Youyu pointed to the stage below. "It's about to start."

In the audience, when Lin Xiuhong saw Li Luo's figure appear on stage, she finally truly confirmed what Li Guohong had said was true.

"When did this kid secretly learn guitar?" Lin Xiuhong whispered to Li Guohong. "He still has to write his web novel when he gets home, and he has to study on top of that. Does he really have this much energy?"

"Isn't that a good thing?" Li Guohong considered it seriously. "Actually, he's just using the time he used to spend playing games on these things instead."

"Didn't he used to be good at basketball and games, and still have the energy to cause trouble at school?"

"He's just channeling his energy into where it should truly be used now."

Hearing him say this, Lin Xiuhong couldn't help but nod. "You actually make a lot of sense."

But when Li Guohong thought of Yuan Wanqing sitting next to him, he still had to add, "Our Li Luo probably hasn't been playing the guitar for very long. If he doesn't play well in a bit, please be understanding."

"You don't have to be so polite," Yuan Wanqing said with a laugh. "At school, I'm just Yan Zhusheng's mother. It's a performance by children, I won't be that strict."

"Why do you have a microphone too?" On stage, Shao Youpeng glanced at the mic in front of Li Luo and asked with curiosity.

"I asked him to help me with backing vocals." Yan Zhusheng was adjusting her own microphone, and upon hearing Shao Youpeng's question, she turned her head to explain.

Niu Qingling paused for a moment, then asked curiously, "Did you two practice privately?"

"Mhm," Yan Zhusheng nodded. "Don't worry."

"Then let's do it," Niu Qingling smiled. "It was originally a preview for the sports meet anyway, let's just treat it as a rehearsal. No need to be too nervous."

"Good thing the second-year parents aren't coming," Shao Youpeng chuckled. "Otherwise, if my parents were in the stands, I'd probably get shaky hands."

"Could you consider my feelings, please?" Xie Shuchen retorted. "My mom is right there in the stands."

"Which one?" Niu Qingling looked over at the stands.

But before Xie Shuchen could even point her out, an auntie in the stands had already stood up and shouted towards the stage, "Shuchen! You can do it! Mom's here!"

"Damn!" Xie Shuchen awkwardly waved at his mom, while the others beside him started snickering. "What are you guys laughing at? Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng, didn't your parents come?"

"They did." Yan Zhusheng pointed in Yuan Wanqing's direction, then asked Li Luo, "The auntie next to Uncle, is that your mom?"

"Yeah." Li Luo nodded, holding back a laugh. "My parents both came."

Perhaps inspired or provoked by Xie Shuchen's mother, just as Li Luo was suppressing his laughter, Lin Xiuhong also couldn't resist standing up and shouting towards the stage, "Li Luo, you can do it! Your dad and I are both watching!"

Li Luo: "..."

"Hahaha!" Xie Shuchen laughed without restraint. "Serves you right! For laughing at me."

After teasing each other like this, everyone's nervous feelings eased up quite a bit.

And Xie Shuchen and Shao Youpeng also quickly spotted Ying Chanxi and Xu Youyu in the stands.

Noticing the two girls' gazes, they both became fully energized and began to seriously prepare for the upcoming performance.

After the student in charge of the backstage audio came on stage to confirm with Niu Qingling, Xu Youyu received a message passed along by a member of the student council and nodded, indicating they could start at any time.

So, a moment later, when Niu Qingling struck the first note, the gazes of all the parents present were immediately drawn to the stage.

"It's starting, it's starting." Lin Xiuhong sat up straight, her hands clasped tightly on her knees, her expression instantly growing tense. "Let's see how your son performs."

"You're even more nervous than the kid."

"Don't talk so much." Lin Xiuhong shot him a glare. "Listen to the song."

While the couple bickered, the guitar in Li Luo's hands also began to play.

Yuan Wanqing narrowed her eyes slightly, listening carefully to the intro.

To be honest, in Yuan Wanqing's eyes, their coordination was still quite average.

Especially since the quality of the school's sound system wasn't that great, the audio was mediocre.

But for a group of young high school students, this was already a truly impressive level.

Especially Li Luo... Yuan Wanqing carefully distinguished the guitar's tone in the intro and raised her eyebrows.

It was surprisingly not bad.

His grasp of the rhythm was a bit better than the others.

But ordinary parents wouldn't be able to tell, they were mainly just listening for the novelty.

And at that moment, Yan Zhusheng, standing in the center of the stage, gently rested both hands on the microphone stand before her and slowly closed her eyes.

When she opened them again, the audience was no longer in her vision; passion began to build up energy in her chest.

"I am not a stone"

"Nor am I a teardrop"

"I am just a little bird"

"Searching for the way home"

The moment Yan Zhusheng started singing, her clear and cool vocal tone instantly made the parents' eyes light up; it was a different style from the original singer.

But it was just as catchy.

As expected of Yuan Wanqing's daughter, her musical talent is truly something else... Li Guohong thought to himself, not paying any attention to his own son's performance at all.

But at the exact moment this song, "Brave Heart," entered its chorus—

"This is the feeling of flying!"

"This is the feeling of freedom!"

As Yan Zhusheng's high notes soared, Li Luo, standing to the side, also began to sing out loud.

Layered over the original clear, cold voice, like a fresh mountain spring, was a voice as heavy as a mountain, instantly elevating the song's quality by a level.

It became more flavorful.

This made Yuan Wanqing's eyes brighten. "This arrangement is quite good."

The professional said.

But the two ordinary parents next to her weren't thinking that much; they were simply enjoying it.

Seeing their own son shine on stage, they felt a warm current flow through their hearts.

Just a few months ago, Lin Xiuhong and Li Guohong probably wouldn't have dared to even imagine that this scene today would actually appear before their eyes.

And the impassioned music at this moment seemed to pull them into a dream.

One song, "Brave Heart," quickly came to an end.

The five people on stage were now completely in the zone, lost in the performance. Under Niu Qingling's controlled rhythm, they quickly transitioned into the next song.

"'Soaring Life'." As soon as Li Guohong heard the intro, he recognized it. "I like this one."

"How many times have I fallen on the road"

"How many times have I broken my wings"

Yan Zhusheng handled it with ease, her entire state becoming more and more relaxed, her movements no longer confined to just standing still.

When she reached the climax of the chorus, she snatched the microphone from its stand and sang out loud with great style:

"I want a soaring life!"

"Like flying in the vast sky!"

With Li Luo providing backing vocals, the song's completeness was quite good.

But perhaps because she got carried away while singing, Yan Zhusheng's grip on the microphone was a bit too forceful, and she accidentally stepped on the mic cable on the floor.

The next second... she lost her voice.

Or rather, the microphone lost its sound.

Yan Zhusheng subconsciously froze for a moment, turning her head to look at Li Luo.

At this point, they had entered the instrumental break.

But the instrumental break in the middle of "Soaring Life" was very short. Before Yan Zhusheng could explain the situation, the song had already reached the next verse.

"Is something wrong?" Xu Youyu frowned. "Is the microphone broken?"

A ripple of confused murmurs went through the stands, as many parents had also noticed the situation.

The feeling of worry immediately affected Xie Shuchen and the others on stage.

But soon, Li Luo's steady singing voice rang out.

"How many times have I lost my way"

"How many times have my dreams been shattered"

Unlike Yan Zhusheng's style, Li Luo casually took over, steadily picking up the subsequent lyrics.

At the same time, Li Luo winked at Yan Zhusheng, signaling her to come and take his microphone.

But for some reason, after Yan Zhusheng put her own microphone back, she walked directly to Li Luo's side, leaned into his mic, and sang along with him:

"I want a soaring life!"

"Like standing at the peak of a rainbow!"

The two of them shared a single microphone, their sides pressed tightly together.

Li Luo's guitar-playing fingers even stiffened for a moment before he got back into the rhythm.

In the stands, Ying Chanxi watched this scene, lightly biting her lip. Her hands, which were resting on the railing, clenched a little tighter.

(End of Chapter)
